description: (Na)₂AgAlCl₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a AgAlCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the AgAlCl₆ framework, Ag is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form AgCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AlCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ag-Cl bond lengths are 2.69 Å. Al is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form AlCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AgCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Al-Cl bond lengths are 2.34 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Ag and one Al atom.
